b.x: The drill doctrine is in the field Drill with children · Family evacuation.
In the real house: clock, bag, stairs, near point. Here the clock only marks. No story.
02 Child by the hand or on the hip. Nobody ahead.
03 Take the door bag. Not the house.
05 Walk to the near point. Clock on arrival.

01 When the trigger fires, where are the children? Written agreement: home, school or split. Who fetches is named. We’ll figure it out. Someone fetches. It is not on paper. We never spoke. In chaos we’ll call.

02 Does the child know the near point — for real? Yes. Names the place. Already walked it. No house address on the badge. I know. She forgets. We have not drilled this year. It is still ‘we’ll meet’. No place.
03 The three-word note: does she say it out loud? Name, house phone, the point. No terror. A short game. We drilled once. She already forgot. Not yet. Or I taught it with an end-of-world film.

04 At the door: is the child by the hand — or ‘go ahead’? Hand or hip. Heads counted. Nobody leaves alone. The oldest already goes ahead. I know it is slack. Each one runs. Then we’ll find each other.
05 She forgot the toy. Do you go back? No. The thing is not worth the person. Agreed before, on Tuesday. If it is close, maybe. We have not agreed yet. I go back. She cries. The danger can wait.

06 Someone sweet offers: ‘I’ll take the children’. No. I thank them. Who fetches is on the sheet. Law 12 of the 41. If I know them by sight… it is still a doubt. I accept to speed it up. In chaos everyone helps.

07 Building, a tired child, the lift works. Do you get in? Stairs. Always. The drill already climbed with the real load. Fire and water, stairs. Blackout… maybe the lift. The lift. She cannot take the stairs. I never trained.

08 The two-minute drill: has it been done this half-year — with no film? Yes. Clock, bag, stairs, near point. No terror, no story. We talked. We did not time it. The child did not take part. It is still a video. Or I filmed it for the group.
